name: kiterp
description: Run frontend apps from the repo root (each app lives in its own folder). Use npm run dev to start admin (:3000), vendor (:3001), and storefront (:3002) together.

scripts.dev:
node -e "console.log('
  All three Vite apps start here. Wait for Local: lines for ports 3000, 3001, and 3002.
  If you only run npm run dev inside frontend/, only :3000 exists.
  In Cursor: Terminal → Run Task → Dev: ALL web apps (3000 + 3001 + 3002).
')" && concurrently -n admin,vendor,storefront -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:vendor" "npm run dev:storefront"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix vendor-web && npm install --prefix storefront-web && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:aws: npm run build:bundle --prefix vendor-web && npm run build --prefix storefront-web && npm run build:bundle --prefix frontend
